{{Character Infobox |color={{Grass color}} |corecolor={{Grass color light}} |bordercolor={{Grass color dark}} |name=Niko |jname=ルカ |tmname=Luka |text=fff |image=Niko.png |size=250px |caption=Niko |gender=Female |eyes=Blue |hair=Blue |hometown=Unknown |region=Unknown }} {{Character Infobox/Anime |color={{grass color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'' |debut=''[[HZ053|Hatenna and the Otherworldly]]'' |enva=[[Kira Buckland]] |jpva=Hikaru Takahashi }} |} '''Niko''' (Japanese: '''ルカ''' ''Luka'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|HZ}}. She is [[Liko]]'s [[doppelgänger]]. ==History== [[File:Niko Naranja Academy uniform.png|250px|left|thumb|Niko in her [[Naranja Academy]] uniform]] Niko is a {{pkmn|Trainer}} who came from her home region to study at [[Naranja Academy]] in the [[Tera Training]] course. In ''[[HZ053|Hatenna and the Otherworldly]]'', while traveling with her friends [[Rob]] and [[Dash]], the group became lost in the same forest as [[Liko]], [[Roy]], and [[Dot]]. After wandering aimlessly for a while, Niko used a vine from a nearby tree to replace a broken strap on her handbag. This sparked the fury of an {{p|Annihilape}}, as the vine was how it reached its food supply. The group was chased by Annihilape for days until they met Liko and her friends. Despite Roy's insistence that they battle the [[wild Pokémon]] together, Niko and her friends fled out of the forest. In ''[[HZ055|Showdown! The Paldea Elite Four]]'', Niko and her friends were welcomed by [[Clavell]] and [[Jacq]] along with the other students who had submitted their school reports and thus completed the first part of the training course. In ''[[HZ057|The Terapagos I Don't Know]]'', Niko, Rob, and Dash participated in Clavell's speech that started the second part of Tera Training. In ''[[HZ066|Infiltrating the System! Naranja Academy in Danger!]]'', during the conclusion of the course, she, Rob, and Dash heard Clavell's speech regarding the [[Tera Training Student Battle Tournament]] that will be held for the course's students. After seeing that Dash had been saddened by failing her exam, Niko tried to cheer her up. Later, Niko was seen battling [[Ann]] in the first round of the tournament. Niko reappeared in [[HZ126]], alongside Rob and Dash at Naranja Academy. She battled against Rob, using Roserade to battle his {{p|Darmanitan}} and later watched Dash battling Liko over whether the [[Strong Sphere]]'s would remain banned. Following Dash's loss, Niko supported Dash. In [[HZ136]], Niko, Dash, and Rob were seen helping take away discarded Strong Spheres after [[Spinel]] was defeated and his crimes were exposed to the public. ==Character== Although not much of her personality was shown, in ''[[HZ066|Infiltrating the System! Naranja Academy in Danger!]]'' it was shown that Niko has a supportive side, trying to cheer up [[Dash]] after her friend failed the [[Tera Training]]. ==Pokémon== This listing is of Niko's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|HZ}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Niko |pkmn=Roserade |type1=Grass |type2=Poison |img=Niko Roserade.png |epnum=HZ053 |epname=Hatenna and the Otherworldly |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Roserade}} is Niko's only known Pokémon and is usually seen [[Walking Pokémon|outside of its Poké Ball]]. In ''[[HZ053|Hatenna and the Otherworldly]]'', Roserade was seen injured alongside her Trainer when she encountered [[Liko]], [[Roy]], and [[Dot]] in the forest. After the two groups were introduced to each other, {{TP|Liko|Hatenna}} healed the injuries of Roserade and her fellow Pokémon. In ''[[HZ066|Infiltrating the System! Naranja Academy in Danger!]]'', Roserade was used in a battle against [[Ann]]'s {{p|Dewott}} in the [[Tera Training Student Battle Tournament]]. The winner of the battle was not seen.
